Name: Dray's Four Seasons Greenhouse
Author: Draylon
Description:
A Greenhouse with 4 51x51 Rooms, each one locked to a season. Each room spawns a small amount of forage for that season, as well as has Mountain, Forest/River, and Beach Fishing areas for that season. Berry Bushes Spawn berries in every season on their spawn days. Winter Room has a Quarry. All Grass is Tillable. You can Also build buildings in them.

Beach Fishing is self explanatory, Forest/River are in the River segments and Mountain are in the lake looking segments, Note on the Winter Map, the Quarry Pool is still Forest Fish, the Large area to the East is the Mountain Fish area.

BE CAREFUL ABOUT PLANTING FRUIT TREES, Trees are placeable and will grow in any of the 4 rooms, but ONLY PRODUCE FRUIT in the seasonally appropriate room.

Should be compatible with anything that doesn't modify the greenhouse.

Downloads.Description: Please let me know if you encounter any bugs.
